name: Server Settings
description: Configure server hostname, port, startup boot service, power controls, and admin account password

commands.enable_boot_service_sudo:
mkdir -p /usr/local/bin && (cp ./debian-server-manager /usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager 2>/dev/null || cp /proc/self/exe /usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager 2>/dev/null || (which go >/dev/null && go build -o /usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager main.go)) && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager && CUR_DIR="$(pwd)" && printf '[Unit]
Description=Debian Server Manager Web App
After=network.target network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=%s
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
User=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
' "$CUR_DIR" > /etc/systemd/system/debian-server-manager.service && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable debian-server-manager
commands.disable_boot_service_sudo: systemctl disable debian-server-manager || true && rm -f /etc/systemd/system/debian-server-manager.service /usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager && systemctl daemon-reload
